import { APIResource } from '../../core/resource.js';

import type {
  Item,
  ListBoxesResponse,
  ListItemsResponse,
} from '../models.js';

/**
 * Query and header parameters for `listItems`.
 */
export interface ListItemsParams {
  limit?: number;
  cursor?: string;
}

/**
 * Query and header parameters for `listBoxes`.
 */
export interface ListBoxesParams {
  cursor?: string;
}

/**
 * Operations tagged `Items`.
 */
export class ItemsResource extends APIResource {
  /**
   * `GET /items`
   */
  list(params?: ListItemsParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<ListItemsResponse> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: '/items',
      query: pick(params, ['limit', 'cursor']),
      options,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Iterate every item returned by `listItems`, following the `cursor` cursor until the server
   * reports no further pages.
   */
  listAll(params?: ListItemsParams, options?: RequestOptions): AsyncIterableIterator<Item> {
    return autoPaginate<Item>(
      (cursor) => this.list({ ...params, cursor }, options),
      'items',
      'cursor',
      'has_more',
    );
  }

  /**
   * `GET /boxes`
   */
  listBoxes(params?: ListBoxesParams, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<ListBoxesResponse> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: '/boxes',
      query: pick(params, ['cursor']),
      options,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Iterate every item returned by `listBoxes`, following the `cursor` cursor until the server
   * reports no further pages.
   */
  listBoxesAll(params?: ListBoxesParams, options?: RequestOptions): AsyncIterableIterator<Item> {

      'boxes',
      'cursor',
